Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets

run_go_ora.Rd

Performs GO enrichment analysis for each cluster-specific DEG list using clusterProfiler::enrichGO. Produces a QC summary table of tested versus retained gene sets per cluster.

Usage

run_go_ora(
  de_list,
  org_db,
  universe = NULL,
  use_tested_universe = FALSE,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.1,
  ont = "BP",
  split_direction = FALSE,
  simplify = FALSE,
  simplify_cutoff = 0.7,
  outputDir = NULL,
  outname = "GO_ORA_QC_summary.csv"
)

Arguments

de_list

The output of run_cluster_de: a named list whose elements each contain a $degs data frame (with a gene column of DEG symbols) and a $tested data frame (with a gene column of every gene tested in that cluster).

org_db

An OrgDb annotation object (e.g., org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db for mouse, org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db for human).

universe

Character vector of background gene symbols used as the enrichment universe for every cluster (e.g., rownames(seurat_obj)). If NULL (default), enrichGO uses all genes annotated in org_db. Ignored when use_tested_universe = TRUE.

use_tested_universe

Logical. If TRUE, each cluster's universe is the gene column of de_list[[cluster]]$tested (the genes FindMarkers actually tested in that cluster), and universe is ignored. Default FALSE.

keyType

Character string specifying the gene identifier type. Default "SYMBOL".

qvalueCutoff

Numeric. q-value (BH-adjusted p-value) threshold for retaining enriched terms. Default 0.1.

ont

Character string specifying the GO sub-ontology to test: "BP" (Biological Process), "MF" (Molecular Function), "CC" (Cellular Component), or "ALL". Default "BP".

split_direction

Logical. If TRUE, each cluster's DEGs are split by the sign of avg_log2FC and ORA is run separately on the up-regulated (avg_log2FC > 0) and down-regulated genes, using the same universe for both. Results from a split run must be written with write_go(..., split_direction = TRUE). Default FALSE.

simplify

Logical. If TRUE, redundant GO terms are removed from each result with clusterProfiler::simplify(), which groups terms by semantic similarity in the GO hierarchy (Wang measure) and keeps the term with the lowest adjusted p-value from each group. Applied to the significant terms only, and to the up and down results separately when split_direction = TRUE. Not available with ont = "ALL". Default FALSE, because the overlap networks in run_comparison_networks already group redundant terms, and the number of terms in a network cluster is itself informative.

simplify_cutoff

Numeric [0, 1]. Semantic-similarity cutoff passed to clusterProfiler::simplify(); terms more similar than this are treated as redundant. Higher values remove fewer terms. Only used when simplify = TRUE. Default 0.7.

outputDir

Character path to the directory where the QC summary CSV is written. Created if it does not exist.

outname

Character filename for the QC summary CSV. Default "GO_ORA_QC_summary.csv".

Value

A named list (one element per cluster). Elements are NULL for clusters with no DEGs. Otherwise:

  • split_direction = FALSE: a single enrichResult.

  • split_direction = TRUE: a list with $up and $down enrichResult objects; either is NULL when that direction has no DEGs.

Each result table gains a cluster column, and a direction column when split. With simplify = TRUE, each result holds only the significant, non-redundant terms. A QC summary CSV is also written to <outputDir>/<outname>, with one row per cluster, or one row per cluster and direction when split. Its tested and retained columns count terms before simplifying; an after_simplify column is added when simplify = TRUE.

Details

For each cluster, the function:

  1. Extracts unique gene symbols from the DE data frame, split into up and down sets when split_direction = TRUE.

  2. Calls clusterProfiler::enrichGO with minGSSize = 5, maxGSSize = 300, BH adjustment, and readable = TRUE.

  3. Annotates the result with the cluster name.

  4. Optionally removes redundant terms with clusterProfiler::simplify().

  5. Prints a per-cluster summary of tested/retained gene sets.
